name: Anhalinine
summary: Anhalinine, also known as O-methylanhalamine or mescaline-CR, is a tetrahydroisoquinoline alkaloid found in Lophophora williamsii (peyote) and other cacti. It is structurally related to mescaline and is a cyclized phenethylamine analogue of mescaline. Anhalinine is also pharmacologically active, but is only a minor constituent of peyote and is unlikely to contribute to its effects.

pharmacology.text: Simple tetrahydroisoquinoline alkaloids of mescaline-containing cacti like anhalinine have received relatively little investigation. Arthur Heffter found several of them to produce no effects similar to those of mescaline. However, some of them have been found to produce convulsions in animals at high doses. Anhalinine specifically has been described as having "stimulant" properties due to inhibiting cholinergic neurotransmission.

uses.en: It has no medical or recreational use of its own. It is of interest mainly to chemists and botanists studying the alkaloids of mescaline-bearing cacti.
uses.zh: 它本身沒有醫療或娛樂用途，主要引起研究含麥斯卡林仙人掌生物鹼的化學家與植物學家的興趣。
uses.zhHans: 它本身没有医疗或娱乐用途，主要引起研究含麦斯卡林仙人掌生物碱的化学家与植物学家的兴趣。

sideEffects.en: Arthur Heffter, who first isolated mescaline, tested several of these simple cactus alkaloids and found they did not produce mescaline-like effects. Their effects in people are otherwise barely documented.
sideEffects.zh: 首次分離出麥斯卡林的 Arthur Heffter 測試過幾種這類簡單的仙人掌生物鹼，發現它們不會產生類似麥斯卡林的作用。除此之外，它們對人體的影響幾乎沒有紀錄。
sideEffects.zhHans: 首次分离出麦斯卡林的 Arthur Heffter 测试过几种这类简单的仙人掌生物碱，发现它们不会产生类似麦斯卡林的作用。除此之外，它们对人体的影响几乎没有纪录。

fact.en: It is found in peyote alongside mescaline, and is sometimes called mescaline-CR because it is mescaline whose side chain has been closed into an extra ring.
fact.zh: 它與麥斯卡林一同存在於佩奧特仙人掌中，有時被稱為 mescaline-CR，因為它就是麥斯卡林的側鏈閉合成額外一個環的結構。
fact.zhHans: 它与麦斯卡林一同存在于佩奥特仙人掌中，有时被称为 mescaline-CR，因为它就是麦斯卡林的侧链闭合成额外一个环的结构。
